## Guides

- [How to Get the 2000s Digicam (CCD) Look With a Date Stamp on iPhone](https://qwerpap.github.io/vintage-camera-legal/how-to-get-2000s-digicam-ccd-look-with-date-stamp-on-iphone): Use Graino's Pocket 03 camera for an early-2000s CCD digicam look with the classic orange date stamp.
- [How to Make iPhone Photos Look Like Film](https://qwerpap.github.io/vintage-camera-legal/how-to-make-iphone-photos-look-like-film): Shoot with a film-look camera on iPhone and get a print that matches the viewfinder.
- [How to Shoot a Disposable-Camera Style Roll on iPhone and Develop It Later](https://qwerpap.github.io/vintage-camera-legal/how-to-shoot-disposable-camera-roll-on-iphone): Shoot a roll of 24 frames in Graino and wait for the lab to develop it, like a real film camera.
- [How to Turn Photos From Your Library Into Film Prints on iPhone](https://qwerpap.github.io/vintage-camera-legal/how-to-turn-library-photos-into-film-prints-on-iphone): Develop photos you already have as film prints in Graino, one at a time or up to 50 at once with Pro.
